mapper.select: SELECT room_id, room_nm, capacity, location, equipments, use_yn FROM gw_room WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY room_id
SELECT room_id, room_nm, capacity, location, equipments, use_yn FROM gw_room WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_room_res (room_id, user_id, start_dt, end_dt, purpose) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{userId}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, #{purpose})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_room_res SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE res_id = #{resId} AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{roleCd} IN ('ADMIN','HR_MANAGER'))
mapper.sql: r.res_id, r.room_id, m.room_nm, r.user_id, u.name AS user_name, r.start_dt, r.end_dt, r.purpose, r.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_room_res r JOIN gw_room m ON m.room_id = r.room_id JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.res_id = #{resId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM gw_room_res r JOIN gw_room m ON m.room_id = r.room_id JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.start_dt DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT FROM gw_room_res r JOIN gw_room m ON m.room_id = r.room_id JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.end_dt >= #{from} ORDER BY r.start_dt LIMIT #{limit}
